https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/alerts (alerts listed on the campground page: none for Baker's Hole or US-191), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $26 non-electric, $35 electric (includes 2 vehicles); $9 each additional vehicle. 'Federal Recreation Passes not applicable toward electric' or additional vehicle fees. The Forest Service page also still carries an older table ($20 / $28 / $8).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/bakers-hole-campground ('$26.00 for non-electric sites. Includes 2 driving vehicles', '$35.00 for electrical sites', '$9.00 each additional vehicle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10231392/rates (2026: StandardNonelectric 26, StandardElectric 35), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 73 sites and 1 picnic site; 33 electric sites (the recreation.gov catalog types 34 RV ELECTRIC). Trailer/RV parking spurs average 25 x 75 ft; the catalog lists 30 sites at 40 ft and one at 45, and 28 sites at 20 ft or less.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/bakers-hole-campground ('Camp sites: 73 camp sites, 1 picnic site', 'Electrical Sites: 33', 'Trailer/RV sites average parking spur: 25' X 75'') + recreation.gov catalog (max vehicle length per site), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov public campsite catalog for facility 10231392 (Water Hookup 'No' on all 73 sites), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/bakers-hole-campground ('No RV Dump Station', 'NO Shower Facilities available at this campground', 'Potable water is available at this site') + recreation.gov notices, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Seasons of Use 5/1 – 10/11. Weather Dependent.' recreation.gov 2026: first-come May 1-14, reservable May 15 - September 26, first-come September 27 - October 10.

Run by concessionaire ExplorUS. 44 sites reservable on recreation.gov (May 15 - September 26 in 2026), 29 first-come; the whole campground is first-come in the shoulder seasons (early May, late September - October 10). recreation.gov stops taking reservations 3 days before arrival. 16 consecutive nights.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10231392 (rules: reservationCutOff 3, maxConsecutiveStay 16; rate seasons 'First-come, First-served Season'; catalog: 44 reservable, 29 not; contact email @goexplorus.com, notice 'USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/bakers-hole-campground ('Reserve this site on Recreation.gov'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Hebgen Lake RD) campground along the Madison River, 3 mi N of West Yellowstone on US-191; run by concessionaire ExplorUS. Long spurs (avg 25x75 ft) fit big rigs. Bear-country hard-sided-only rules in spring. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 73 sites (33 electric), no showers or dump, potable water, $26 non-electric / $35 electric (2026), recreation.gov booking. Changed season close 09-27 -> 10-11 (FS 'Seasons of Use 5/1 - 10/11') and added opens 05-01; fcfs after_cutoff -> some_sites (29 non-reservable sites, all-FCFS shoulder seasons); added 3-day reservation cutoff, 16-night max, 45-ft max (catalog), no water hookups, concessionaire ExplorUS. Not stated: amperage (derived 50 left), vault toilets (FS page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site' but lists an accessible toilet; derived left). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: Hebgen Lake Ranger District (406) 823-6961 (Forest Service page); recreation.gov lists 406-646-1002 for the facility and (661) 702-1420 for facility information (concessionaire ExplorUS).

Forest Service page contradicts itself: 'Restrooms are not available at this site' vs an accessible toilet listed; and two fee tables ($20/$28 and $26/$35; the second matches recreation.gov). Derived vault_toilets true left in place.
recreation.gov's facility coordinates (44.66552, -111.09981) are in West Yellowstone town, about 4 km south of the campground; the Forest Service gives 44.70387, -111.10131, matching our pin.
